_disclaimer: Deterministic fixture around one observed retrieval confusion (docs/camera_hard_negative_analysis.md). Both sides are references to the already-verified, catalog-grounded articles in tests/fixtures/cross_domain_articles.json (SYNTHETIC DOMAIN GENERALIZATION FIXTURE) -- not new invented content, not an unrelated negative. Every canonical_query and paraphrase here is copied verbatim from that fixture so both files stay in sync; see that file for the article content and verified deeplink targets.

positive.canonical_query: My camera app won't open on my Galaxy phone, it just doesn't launch at all.
paraphrases: The camera app just refuses to open when I tap it.
Nothing happens when I try to launch the camera.
Why won't my camera app open at all?
This is so annoying, I tap the camera icon and literally nothing happens.

hard_negative.canonical_query: My camera app keeps crashing or freezing whenever I try to take a photo.
paraphrases: The camera freezes up every time I try to snap a picture.
Camera app crashes constantly when I open it.
Why does my camera app keep freezing when I try to use it?
It's so frustrating, the camera crashes almost every single time I open it.

confusable_query.text: This is so annoying, I tap the camera icon and literally nothing happens.
confusable_query.source: positive.paraphrases[4] -- authored as a paraphrase of camera_wont_open_permission, observed in scripts/benchmark_cross_domain.py to retrieve camera_crashes_freezes instead
confusable_query.why_confusable: Ambiguous between 'the app never launches' (a permission/launch problem) and 'the app launches and immediately dies' (a crash); a real customer complaint phrased this way could plausibly mean either.

expected_ranking.rule: For every text listed under positive.paraphrases (including the confusable_query, which is one of them), the correct top-1 retrieval target is camera_wont_open_permission. For every text under hard_negative.paraphrases, the correct top-1 target is camera_crashes_freezes.
expected_ranking.known_exception: positive.paraphrases[4] (confusable_query) currently retrieves camera_crashes_freezes at rank 1 with the current, non-fine-tuned embedding model -- this is the one frozen-baseline failure this fixture exists to track (see docs/camera_hard_negative_analysis.md and tests/test_camera_hard_negative.py).
